Confirmed — PR #599 now includes both the original PR content and the new fix commit. Work is complete.

## Summary

Fixed the audit-confirmed CSV/formula-injection vulnerability on PR #599 (`worker/task-20260727-101145-reporting-api-gateway--external-ai-scope`):

1. **`src/lib/report-export-shared.ts`** — `csvEscape()` now prefixes any cell value starting with `=`, `+`, `-`, or `@` with a leading single quote before the existing comma/quote/newline escaping, applied to every cell (defense-in-depth against any user-controlled field).
2. **`src/app/api/v1/reports/catalog/route.ts`** — null-orgId now returns `400 "No organisation found"`, matching `.../run`'s contract (was `200 { catalog: [] }`).
3. Added tests proving payloads like `=1+1`, `@SUM(A1:A9)`, `-2+3` are neutralized and recoverable (stripping the prefix restores the exact original text), normal text is byte-identical, and the catalog/run consistency fix.

Verified: `npx tsc --noEmit` clean, `bun test` — 2163 pass / 0 fail across 193 files (including the 4 new/changed test cases). Pushed directly to PR #599's existing branch (commit `4cd3bfea`), no new PR opened, tenant-isolation and XLSX paths untouched as instructed.

The tenant-isolation logic and XLSX export path were left untouched per the audit's own findings. This still requires a fresh supervisor audit before merge per AGENTS.md Rule 7c — I have not merged it.
